description:
Correct a saved new-message draft. Name only the fields that change: text or html replaces the whole body, and files stay unless attachments is given (read the draft first for current file ids). The draft id and review_url stay the same, and message_id changes. It sends nothing. Supported HTML: p, br, strong/b, em/i, u, s, a (http, https, mailto, tel), ul, ol, li, blockquote, code, pre, h2, h3, span/mark with the composer's styles, and inline cid: images. h1 becomes h2. Tables and h4-h6 are not supported: their text stays as paragraphs and removed_formatting lists them ('table' for any table part, 'h4', ...), as it lists other dropped elements such as script, style or iframe. Attributes and inline styles outside the composer set are dropped and not reported. Paragraphs are already spaced like the Shipmail composer, so do not add


between them. When html is given without text, the text part is derived from it.

attachments.description: Replaces the draft's files, in this order: { id } keeps a current file (ids from the latest draft read), { staged_attachment_id } adds an upload from shipmail_prepare_staged_attachment_upload. [] removes them all; leave it out to keep them. At most 20 files and 25 MB in total.

draft_id.description: The draft's id, returned when it was saved.

id.description: Mailbox ID that holds the draft.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key. If omitted, the MCP server generates one for POST tools.

name: shipmail_update_draft

id.description: Names the file in the stored draft as it is now. It changes after every update; read the draft again for current ids.
The draft's id. It stays the same when the draft is corrected.

message_id.description: Inbox message that holds the draft now. It changes with every correction.

removed_formatting.description: Formatting the HTML sanitiser dropped: 'table' for any table part, 'h4' to 'h6', and other dropped elements such as 'script'. Their text stays as paragraphs.

review_url.description: Link for a person to review this one draft and send it, or null for a test-mode key. The person must be signed in with access to the mailbox. Opening it sends nothing, and it stops working once the draft is sent or deleted, or a person replaces it in the inbox. A correction through the API keeps it working.

title: Correct New Email Draft
